title: LLM edit proposal (outer-edit loop)
description: Shape emitted by the LLM during the outer-edit loop. Proposes one or more jq-path patch operations and provides a rationale.

edits.description: Ordered list of edit operations to apply.

file.description: Path to the spec file to patch, relative to git-root.

jq_path.description: jq-path expression targeting the field to set.

value.description: The new value to assign at jq_path. May be any JSON type.

rationale.description: Free-form explanation of why these edits are proposed and how they address the task.
